name: Donut chart
what: Shares of a whole: a donut (or pie) whose slices draw in one after another around the circle, each slice's number counting up in the legend as it draws; the middle shows the biggest share and that slice pushes out a little.
origin: infographics (pie / donut charts) - the template kinds marketplaces list (Mixkit, Envato Elements, Motion Array, Videohive), researched 2026-10-16
motion: title 14 f; slices draw over 60 f in all (S-curve across the turn), the legend counting with them; the middle back.out 12 f; the biggest slice out 10 f and back
